问.pinyin: Wǒ néng wèn gè wèn tí ma
Wǒ néng wèn yī xiē wèn tí ma
问.en: May I ask a few questions?

问.zh: 我能问一下您的姓名和住址吗？
问.pinyin: Wǒ néng wèn yī xià nín de xìng míng hé zhù zhǐ ma

问.es: ¿Le puedo pedir su nombre y dirección?

一起.zh: 我没有一个愿意跟我一起旅行的人。
一起.pinyin: Wǒ méi yǒu yī ge yuàn yì gēn wǒ yī qǐ lǚ xíng de rén
一起.en: I don't have anyone who'd travel with me.
一起.es: No tengo a nadie que quiera viajar conmigo.

一起.pinyin: Hé wǒ men yī qǐ lái ba

一起.zh: 你不和我一起喝点茶吗？
一起.pinyin: Nǐ bù hé wǒ yī qǐ hē diǎn chá ma
一起.en: Won't you have some tea with me?
一起.es: ¿Gustaría usted servirse una taza de té conmigo?

一起.zh: 可以的话你也一起来吧。
一起.pinyin: Kě yǐ de huà nǐ yě yī qǐ lái ba
一起.en: Come along with us if you like.

说话.zh: 坐在我旁边的男人跟我说话了。
说话.pinyin: Zuò zài wǒ páng biān de nán rén gēn wǒ shuō huà le
说话.en: The man sitting next to me spoke to me.
说话.es: Me habló el hombre que estaba sentado a mi lado.

说话.pinyin: Bù yào hé wǒ shuō huà
Bù yào shuō huà hǎo bu hǎo

说话.zh: 嘴里有东西的时候不准说话。
说话.pinyin: Zuǐ lǐ yǒu dōng xi de shí hou bù zhǔn shuō huà
说话.en: You must not speak with your mouth full.
说话.es: No hables con la boca llena.

晚上.pinyin: Wǒ zuó tiān wǎn shang dào liǎo zhèr
Wǒ tōng cháng zài wǎn shang xǐ zǎo
晚上.en: I usually take a shower in the evening.
晚上.es: Normalmente, me ducho por la noche.

晚上.zh: 谢谢那天晚上请我吃了饭。
晚上.pinyin: Xiè xie nà tiān wǎn shang qǐng wǒ chī le fàn
晚上.en: Thanks very much for having me to dinner the other night.
晚上.es: Muchas gracias por haberme invitado a cenar la otra noche.

晚上.pinyin: Zuó tiān wǎn shang xià dà xuě le
晚上.en: It snowed a good deal last night.

机场.zh: 我父母去机场送我叔叔了。
机场.pinyin: Wǒ fù mǔ qù jī chǎng sòng wǒ shū shu le
机场.en: My parents have gone to the airport to see my uncle off.
机场.es: Mis padres fueron a dejar a mi tío al aeropuerto.

机场.zh: 我一到了机场就打电话给你。
机场.pinyin: Wǒ yī dào liǎo jī chǎng jiù dǎ diàn huà gěi nǐ
机场.en: I'll phone you as soon as I get to the airport.
机场.es: Te llamaré tan pronto llegue al aeropuerto.

机场.zh: 请你告诉我机场怎么去。
机场.pinyin: Qǐng nǐ gào su wǒ jī chǎng zěn me qù
机场.en: Please tell me how to get to the airport.
机场.es: Por favor, dime cómo llegar al aeropuerto.

机场.pinyin: Dào jī chǎng yǒu duō yuǎn

一样.pinyin: Tā men dōu shì yī yàng de ma
Tā hé wǒ yī yàng gāo
一样.en: He is as tall as I.
一样.es: Es igual de alto que yo.

一样.pinyin: Wǒ gǎn jué hǎo xiàng sǐ le yī yàng
一样.es: Me sentía como si estuviese muerto.

一样.zh: 有一天，我会跑得像风一样快。

一样.en: Someday I'll run like the wind.
一样.es: Algún día correré como el viento.

世界.zh: 在我看来，澳洲是世界上最好的国家之一。
世界.pinyin: Zài wǒ kàn lái ào zhōu shì shì jiè shàng zuì hǎo de guó jiā zhī yī
世界.en: From my point of view, Australia is one of the best countries in the world.
世界.es: Desde mi punto de vista, Australia es uno de los mejores países en el mundo.

世界.zh: 但是，在「真实的大人世界」里是有很多竞争的。
世界.pinyin: Dàn shì zài zhēn shí de dà ren shì jiè lǐ shì yǒu hěn duō jìng zhēng de
世界.en: And yet, in the "real adult world" there are a lot of competitions.
世界.es: Sin embargo, en el "mundo de los adultos" hay mucha competencia.

世界.zh: 世界上的教育都让我失望。
世界.pinyin: Shì jiè shàng de jiào yù dōu ràng wǒ shī wàng
世界.en: Education in this world disappoints me.
世界.es: La educación en este mundo me decepciona.

世界.zh: 如果可能的话，我想环游世界。
世界.pinyin: Rú guǒ kě néng de huà wǒ xiǎng huán yóu shì jiè
世界.en: If possible, I'd like to travel around the world.

机会.zh: 我还没有机会看那部电影。
机会.pinyin: Wǒ hái méi yǒu jī huì kàn nà bù diàn yǐng
机会.en: I haven't had a chance to see the movie yet.
机会.es: Todavía no tuve la oportunidad de ver la película.

机会.zh: 我很后悔当时没有把握机会认识她。
机会.pinyin: Wǒ hěn hòu huǐ dāng shí méi yǒu bǎ wò jī huì rèn shi tā
机会.en: I regret missing the chance to meet her.
机会.es: Me arrepiento de haber perdido la oportunidad de encontrarme con ella.

机会.zh: 你应该好好利用这个机会。

矮.pinyin: Wǒ mèi mei bǐ nǐ ǎi
矮.en: My sister is shorter than you.

矮.en: My brother is two years older than I, but he is three centimeters shorter.

邀请.pinyin: Tā yāo qǐng wǒ qù tā jiā

Wǒ men zuó tiān fā chū le yāo qǐng

实在.pinyin: Zhè jiàn shì wǒ shí zài bù dǒng

实在.pinyin: Shí zài bào qiàn lǎo bǎn zài shuì jiào qǐng nín míng tiān zài lái
实在.en: I'm sorry, my boss is sleeping right now. Please come back tomorrow.
实在.es: Lo lamento, en este momento mi jefe está durmiendo. Por favor, vuelva mañana.

邮局.pinyin: Wǒ gāng gang qù le yóu jú
邮局.en: I've just been to the post office.

邮局.es: Esto es una oficina de correos y eso es un banco.

邮局.en: I worked in a post office during the summer vacation.
邮局.es: Trabajé en una oficina de correo durante las vacaciones de verano.

暖和.en: She warmed herself by the fire.

暖和.en: It is warmer today than yesterday.
暖和.es: Hoy hace más calor que ayer.

暖和.pinyin: Yīn wèi qì hòu yòu nuǎn huo yòu shī rùn suǒ yǐ guǎng zhōu yī nián dào tóu dōu yǒu huā

亮.es: Una de las luces no esta funcionando. ¿Cree que pueda venir a echarle un vistazo?

硬币.pinyin: Wǒ men zhì yìng bì jué dìng ba
Ràng wǒ men rēng yìng bì jué dìng ba
硬币.en: Let's decide with a coin toss.

无论如何.zh: 无论如何，我也尽了我的责任。
无论如何.pinyin: Wú lùn rú hé wǒ yě jìn le wǒ de zé rèn
无论如何.en: In any case, I did my duty.
无论如何.es: En todo caso, cumplí con mi deber.

无论如何.zh: 无论如何，我不会改变我的想法。
无论如何.pinyin: Wú lùn rú hé wǒ bù huì gǎi biàn wǒ de xiǎng fǎ
无论如何.en: No matter what happens, I'm not changing my mind.
无论如何.es: No cambiaré de idea pase lo que pase.

无论如何.zh: 无论如何，都不关你的事。
无论如何.pinyin: Wú lùn rú hé dōu bù guān nǐ de shì
无论如何.en: In any case, it's none of your business.
无论如何.es: Sea como sea, no te concierne.

无论如何.zh: 无论如何我明天都会打电话给你。
无论如何.pinyin: Wú lùn rú hé wǒ míng tiān dū huì dǎ diàn huà gěi nǐ
无论如何.en: In any case, I'll call you tomorrow.
无论如何.es: De cualquier manera, te llamo mañana.

两者.zh: 你对批评和自我批评这两者的看法不对。
两者.pinyin: Nǐ duì pī píng hé zì wǒ pī píng zhè liǎng zhě de kàn fǎ bù duì
两者.en: Your way of looking at criticism and self-criticism is not right.
两者.es: Tienes un concepto equivocado de la crítica y autocrítica.

两者.zh: 仔细的比较一下，就会发现两者之间的分别了。
两者.pinyin: Zǐ xì de bǐ jiào yī xià jiù huì fā xiàn liǎng zhě zhī jiān de fēn bié le
两者.en: Compare the two carefully, and you will see the difference.
两者.es: Compara ambos atentamente y verás la diferencia.

两者.pinyin: Wǒ bì xū zài liǎng zhě zhòng xuǎn zé
两者.en: I had to choose between the two.
两者.es: Tuve que escoger entre los dos.

两者.zh: 两者之间只有很小的差别。
两者.pinyin: Liǎng zhě zhī jiān zhǐ yǒu hěn xiǎo de chā bié
两者.en: There is only a marginal difference between the two.
两者.es: Sólo hay una pequeña diferencia entre los dos.

避孕套.zh: 对不起，但是没有避孕套的话是绝对不行的。
避孕套.pinyin: Duì bu qǐ dàn shì méi yǒu bì yùn tào de huà shì jué duì bù xíng de
避孕套.en: Sorry, but there's no way it's happening without a condom.
避孕套.es: Perdona, pero sin preservativo nada de nada.

避孕套.pinyin: Nǐ yòng le bì yùn tào ma
Nǐ yǒu bì yùn tào ma

避孕套.zh: 避孕套是预防艾滋病和许多其他疾病的有效手段。
避孕套.pinyin: Bì yùn tào shì yù fáng ài zī bìng hé xǔ duō qí tā jí bìng de yǒu xiào shǒu duàn
避孕套.en: Condoms are an effective measure to prevent HIV and many other diseases.
避孕套.es: El preservativo es un medio eficaz de prevención del HIV y de muchas otras enfermedades.

新房.zh: 如果我有钱，我会买一个新房子。
新房.pinyin: Rú guǒ wǒ yǒu qián wǒ huì mǎi yī ge xīn fáng zi
新房.en: If I had the money, I would buy a new house.
新房.es: Si tuviera dinero, me compraría una casa nueva.

新房.pinyin: Wǒ gài le dòng xīn fáng zi
Nǐ mǎi le dòng xīn fáng zi

新房.zh: 约翰对他的新房子很自豪。
新房.pinyin: Yuē hàn duì tā de xīn fáng zi hěn zì háo
新房.en: John is very proud of his new house.
新房.es: John está muy orgulloso de su nueva casa.

地板.pinyin: Tāng mǔ cā le dì bǎn

地板.zh: 他把杯子掉到地板上打碎了。
地板.pinyin: Tā bǎ bēi zi diào dào dì bǎn shàng dǎ suì le
地板.en: He dropped the cup and broke it.
地板.es: Dejó caer la copa y se rompió.

地板.pinyin: Dì bǎn shàng quán shì xuè
地板.en: The floor was covered with blood.
地板.es: El suelo estaba todo cubierto de sangre.

地板.zh: 汤姆和玛莉的小儿子喜欢坐在厨房地板上敲打锅碗瓢盆。
地板.pinyin: Tāng mǔ hé mǎ lì de xiǎo ér zi xǐ huan zuò zài chú fáng dì bǎn shàng qiāo dǎ guō wǎn piáo pén
地板.en: Tom and Mary's little boy loves sitting on the kitchen floor banging pots and pans.
地板.es: El pequeño niño de Tom y Mary adora sentarse en el suelo de la cocina y golpetear ollas y cacerolas.

湖里.pinyin: Wǒ men zài hú lǐ yóu le yǒng
Wǒ men jìn qíng zài hú lǐ yóu yǒng
湖里.en: We enjoyed swimming in the lake.

湖里.pinyin: Wǒ men ǒu ěr zài hú lǐ yóu yǒng
湖里.en: We sometimes swim in the lake.
湖里.es: A veces nadamos en el lago.

湖里.pinyin: Zhè ge hú lǐ yǒu hěn duō yú
湖里.en: There are many fish in this lake.
湖里.es: Hay muchos peces en este lago.

赶不上.zh: 如果你不抓紧的话，你就会赶不上火车。
赶不上.pinyin: Rú guǒ nǐ bù zhuā jǐn de huà nǐ jiù huì gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē
赶不上.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the train.
赶不上.es: Si no te das prisa perderás el tren.

赶不上.zh: 再不快点你就要赶不上末班车了。
赶不上.pinyin: Zài bù kuài diǎn nǐ jiù yào gǎn bù shàng mò bān chē le
赶不上.en: If you don't hurry, you'll miss the last train.
赶不上.es: Apúrate, o perderás el último tren.

赶不上.zh: 快点，不然要赶不上火车了。
赶不上.pinyin: Kuài diǎn bù rán yào gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē le
赶不上.en: Be quick, or you will miss the train.
赶不上.es: Apresúrate o te vas a perder el tren.

赶不上.zh: 快点, 否则你会赶不上火车。
赶不上.pinyin: Kuài diǎn fǒu zé nǐ huì gǎn bù shàng huǒ chē
赶不上.en: Hurry up, or you will miss the train.

为人.zh: 人们普遍认为吃得苦中苦，方为人上人。
为人.pinyin: Rén men pǔ biàn rèn wéi chī de kǔ zhōng kǔ fāng wéi rén shàng rén
为人.en: It is generally accepted that a person cannot be successful in life without a lot of hard work.
为人.es: Es algo aceptado de forma general que no se puede ser exitoso en la vida sin mucho trabajo duro.

为人.zh: 核战争将会为人类带来灭亡。
为人.pinyin: Hé zhàn zhēng jiāng huì wéi rén lèi dài lái miè wáng
为人.en: A nuclear war will bring about the destruction of mankind.
为人.es: Una guerra nuclear traerá la destrucción de la humanidad.

为人.zh: 我很喜欢你为人设想的性格。
为人.pinyin: Wǒ hěn xǐ huan nǐ wéi rén shè xiǎng de xìng gé
为人.en: I love how you think of other people's needs before your own.

为人.pinyin: Wǒ wéi rén shēng gǎn dào hěn kāi xīn
为人.en: I get a kick out of life.

全球.zh: 尽管有逆境，建筑师还是获得了享誉全球的荣誉。
全球.pinyin: Jǐn guǎn yǒu nì jìng jiàn zhù shī hái shi huò dé le xiǎng yù quán qiú de róng yù
全球.en: Despite adversity, the architect achieved worldwide fame.
全球.es: A pesar de la adversidad, el arquitecto consiguió fama mundial.

全球.zh: 在城堡最秘密的密室里有全球宝中之宝——《真理经》。
全球.pinyin: Zài chéng bǎo zuì mì mì de mì shì lǐ yǒu quán qiú bǎo zhōng zhī bǎo zhēn lǐ jīng
全球.en: In the most secret chamber of the castle lay the greatest treasure on earth—the Book of Truth.
全球.es: En la cámara más secreta del castillo se encontraba el mayor tesoro sobre la tierra: el Libro de la Verdad.

全球.pinyin: Fàng yǎn quán qiú lì zú běn tǔ

全球.zh: 韩国的娱乐文化在全球都很受欢迎。
全球.pinyin: Hán guó de yú lè wén huà zài quán qiú dōu hěn shòu huān yíng
全球.en: Korean entertainment culture is popular worldwide.

说好.zh: 只会说好听话的朋友,是你最可怕的敌人。
说好.pinyin: Zhǐ huì shuō hǎo tīng huà de péng you shì nǐ zuì kě pà de dí rén
说好.en: A flattering friend is your worst enemy.
说好.es: Un amigo que te halaga es tu peor enemigo.

说好.zh: 她，这么说好了，是个活字典。
说好.pinyin: Tā zhè me shuō hǎo le shì gè huó zì diǎn
说好.en: She is, so to speak, a walking dictionary.
说好.es: Ella es, por así decirlo, un diccionario andante.

罢了.pinyin: Zhǐ shì yī chǎng mèng bà le

罢了.zh: 人生只不过是场梦罢了。
罢了.pinyin: Rén shēng zhǐ bu guò shì chǎng mèng bà le

罢了.zh: 不过是一个文字游戏罢了。
罢了.pinyin: Bù guò shì yī ge wén zì yóu xì bà le

罢了.zh: 你怕啥？就是部电影罢了。
罢了.pinyin: Nǐ pà shá jiù shì bù diàn yǐng bà le
罢了.en: Why are you so scared? It's just a movie.

途中.zh: 我在回家途中碰见了他。
途中.pinyin: Wǒ zài huí jiā tú zhōng pèng jiàn le tā
途中.en: On my way home, I met him.
途中.es: Me encontré con él de camino a casa.

途中.zh: 他在回家途中出了意外。
途中.pinyin: Tā zài huí jiā tú zhōng chū le yì wài
途中.en: He had an accident on his way home.
途中.es: Él tuvo un accidente de camino a casa.

途中.zh: 你回家途中顺道来看看我吧。
途中.pinyin: Nǐ huí jiā tú zhōng shùn dào lái kàn kan wǒ ba
途中.en: Please drop in at my house on your way home.

途中.zh: 这个电子仪器肯定在运输途中损坏了。
途中.pinyin: Zhè ge diàn zǐ yí qì kěn dìng zài yùn shū tú zhōng sǔn huài le
途中.en: This electrical device must have been damaged during delivery.

雨季.zh: 日本的雨季什么时候开始？
雨季.pinyin: Rì běn de yǔ jì shén me shí hou kāi shǐ
雨季.en: When does the rainy season in Japan begin?
雨季.es: ¿Cuándo comienza la temporada lluviosa en Japón?

雨季.zh: 根据天气预报，雨季下周会开始。
雨季.pinyin: Gēn jù tiān qì yù bào yǔ jì xià zhōu huì kāi shǐ
雨季.en: According to the weather report, the rainy season will start next week.
雨季.es: Según el pronóstico meteorológico, la temporada de lluvias empezará la próxima semana.

雨季.zh: 苏丹的雨季已经开始了。
雨季.pinyin: Sū dān de yǔ jì yǐ jīng kāi shǐ le
雨季.en: The rainy season has begun in Sudan.

雨季.pinyin: Jīn nián de yǔ jì lái de hěn zǎo
雨季.en: The rainy season set in early this year.

多个.pinyin: Tāng mǔ yǒu duō ge yín háng zhàng hù
Wǒ men bān yǒu shí duō ge xué sheng
多个.en: Our class has more than ten students.

多个.zh: 他在多个领域取得了成就。
多个.pinyin: Tā zài duō ge lǐng yù qǔ dé le chéng jiù
多个.en: He achieved success in many fields.

多个.zh: 一百多个人在一个火车事故中受了伤。
多个.pinyin: Yī bǎi duō ge rén zài yī ge huǒ chē shì gù zhōng shòu le shāng
多个.en: A hundred people were hurt in a train wreck.

尚未.pinyin: Chūn tiān shàng wèi lái lín

尚未.zh: 据我所知，这本书尚未被翻译成日语。
尚未.pinyin: Jù wǒ suǒ zhī zhè běn shū shàng wèi bèi fān yì chéng rì yǔ
尚未.en: As far as I know, this book has never been translated into Japanese.

尚未.zh: 科学家们尚未找到对这神秘现象的解释。
尚未.pinyin: Kē xué jiā men shàng wèi zhǎo dào duì zhè shén mì xiàn xiàng de jiě shì
尚未.en: The scientists have not found any explanation for the mysterious phenomenon.

尚未.zh: 这则故事最悲情的部分尚未揭晓。
尚未.pinyin: Zhè zé gù shi zuì bēi qíng de bù fen shàng wèi jiē xiǎo
尚未.en: The saddest part of the story remains to be told.

歌唱.zh: 除我以外每个人都在歌唱。
歌唱.pinyin: Chú wǒ yǐ wài měi ge rén dōu zài gē chàng
歌唱.es: Todo el mundo cantaba, excepto yo.

歌唱.zh: 我能听见鸟在窗外歌唱。
歌唱.pinyin: Wǒ néng tīng jiàn niǎo zài chuāng wài gē chàng
歌唱.en: I could hear birds singing outside my window.
歌唱.es: Yo podía escuchar a los pájaros cantar afuera de mi ventana.

歌唱.pinyin: Zhēn xiǎng zài yǔ zhōng fàng shēng gē chàng
歌唱.en: I feel like singing in the rain.
歌唱.es: Tengo ganas de cantar en la lluvia.

歌唱.pinyin: Mài kè gē chàng de hěn hǎo

致命.zh: 他的实验室里有所有最致命的毒。
致命.pinyin: Tā de shí yàn shì lǐ yǒu suǒ yǒu zuì zhì mìng de dú
致命.en: His laboratory contains all the deadliest poisons.
致命.es: Todos los venenos más letales estaban en su laboratorio.

致命.zh: 生命是一种致命的性传染病。
致命.pinyin: Shēng mìng shì yī zhǒng zhì mìng de xìng chuán rǎn bìng
致命.en: Life is a fatal sexually transmitted disease.
致命.es: La vida es una enfermedad mortal sexualmente transmisible.

致命.zh: 有时候口误对政治家来说是致命的。
致命.pinyin: Yǒu shí hou kǒu wù duì zhèng zhì jiā lái shuō shì zhì mìng de
致命.en: A slip of the tongue is sometimes fatal to a politician.
致命.es: A veces un lapsus linguae es fatal para un político.

致命.zh: 矛尖浸在一种致命的毒药里。
致命.pinyin: Máo jiān jìn zài yī zhǒng zhì mìng de dú yào lǐ
致命.en: The tip of the spear was dipped in a deadly poison.
致命.es: La punta de la lanza fue bañada en un veneno mortal.

门铃.zh: 你听见有人按门铃了吗？
门铃.pinyin: Nǐ tīng jiàn yǒu rén àn mén líng le ma
门铃.en: Did you hear someone ring the doorbell?

门铃.es: Sonó el timbre de la puerta.

门铃.pinyin: Nǐ méi tīng dào mén líng xiǎng ma

门铃.zh: 我听到前门的门铃响了。
门铃.pinyin: Wǒ tīng dào qián mén de mén líng xiǎng le
门铃.en: I heard the front doorbell ring.

隐藏.pinyin: Wǒ méi shén me kě yǐn cáng

隐藏.zh: 汤姆隐藏着一个可怕的秘密。
隐藏.pinyin: Tāng mǔ yǐn cáng zhe yī ge kě pà de mì mì
隐藏.en: Tom is hiding a terrible secret.

隐藏.zh: 安娜在家中发现了隐藏的宝藏。
隐藏.pinyin: Ān nà zài jiā zhōng fā xiàn le yǐn cáng de bǎo zàng
隐藏.en: Anna found a hidden treasure in her house.
隐藏.es: Anna encontró un tesoro escondido en su casa.

隐藏.zh: 爱和咳嗽是无法隐藏的。
隐藏.pinyin: Ài hé ké sou shì wú fǎ yǐn cáng de
隐藏.en: Love and cough cannot be hidden.
隐藏.es: El amor, como la tos, no se puede ocultar.

难题.pinyin: Wǒ wèn le tā yī ge nán tí
难题.en: I asked her a difficult question.

难题.pinyin: Tā jiě jué le nán tí

难题.zh: 如何提高工作效率是我们现在要面临的难题。
难题.pinyin: Rú hé tí gāo gōng zuò xiào lǜ shì wǒ men xiàn zài yào miàn lín de nán tí
难题.en: The challenge we are going to face is how to increase work efficiency.

难题.pinyin: Tā zhèng zài sī kǎo zhè ge nán tí
难题.en: He's thinking about this difficult problem.

买房.pinyin: Wǒ zhèng zài cún qián mǎi fáng zi
买房.en: I'm saving money to buy a house.
买房.es: Estoy guardando dinero para comprar una casa.

买房.zh: 他买不起汽车，更不要说买房子了。
买房.pinyin: Tā mǎi bu qǐ qì chē gèng bù yào shuō mǎi fáng zi le
买房.en: He cannot buy a car, still less a house.
买房.es: Él no puede comprarse un coche, y mucho menos una casa.

买房.pinyin: Tā men zài chǔ qián mǎi fáng zi
买房.en: They are saving their money for the purchase of a house.
买房.es: Ellos están ahorrando para adquirir una casa.

低估.pinyin: Bù yào dī gū wǒ de lì liang
Nǐ kě bié dī gū wǒ

低估.zh: 音乐的重要性被低估了。
低估.pinyin: Yīn yuè de zhòng yào xìng bèi dī gū le
低估.en: The importance of music is underrated.
低估.es: La relevancia de la música es subestimada.

卖完.zh: 那些票一个礼拜不到就全卖完了。
卖完.pinyin: Nà xiē piào yī ge lǐ bài bù dào jiù quán mài wán le
卖完.en: The tickets sold out within a week.
卖完.es: Los boletos se agotaron en menos de una semana.

卖完.pinyin: Yào shi mài wán le jiù suàn le
卖完.en: If it’s sold out, then just forget it.

卖完.pinyin: Jīn tiān de nǎi huáng bāo mài wán le
卖完.en: The custard buns are sold out today.

卖完.zh: 不好意思，这本书已经卖完了。
卖完.pinyin: Bù hǎo yì si zhè běn shū yǐ jīng mài wán le
卖完.en: Sorry, the book is out of stock.

摘下.zh: 汤姆摘下了他的老花镜。
摘下.pinyin: Tāng mǔ zhāi xià le tā de lǎo huā jìng
摘下.en: Tom took his reading glasses off.
摘下.es: Tom se quitó sus gafas de leer.

摘下.pinyin: Bǎ nǐ men de mào zi zhāi xià lái
Wǒ zhāi xià mào zi jìn le jiào táng
摘下.en: I took off my hat and entered the church.
摘下.es: Me quité el sombrero y entré a la iglesia.

摘下.pinyin: Tā zhāi xià le yǎn jìng

不能不.zh: 她的父母不能不担心她的伤势。
不能不.pinyin: Tā de fù mǔ bù néng bù dān xīn tā de shāng shì
不能不.en: Her parents can't help worrying about her injuries.
不能不.es: Sus padres no pueden evitar preocuparse por sus heridas.

不能不.pinyin: Wǒ men bù néng bù kǎo lǜ tā
不能不.en: We have to think about it.

不能不.zh: 去外国旅行不能不带护照。
不能不.pinyin: Qù wài guó lǚ xíng bù néng bù dài hù zhào
不能不.en: A passport is something you cannot do without when you go to a foreign country.

乌云.pinyin: Wū yún shì xià yǔ de zhēng zhào
乌云.en: Dark clouds are a sign of rain.
乌云.es: Nubes oscuras son señal de lluvia.

到不行.pinyin: Bǎi lín zuó tiān zài yè shì yù dào qián nǚ yǒu gān gà dào bù xíng
到不行.en: Po-lin ran into his ex at the night market yesterday. It was super awkward.

到访.zh: 我去年夏天到访的是一个位於长野县的小村落。
到访.pinyin: Wǒ qù nián xià tiān dào fǎng de shì yī ge wèi yú cháng yě xiàn de xiǎo cūn luò
到访.en: The village which I visited last summer was a small one in Nagano Prefecture.
到访.es: El pueblo que visité el verano pasado era uno pequeño de la prefectura de Nagano.

到访.zh: 我永远不会忘记去年夏天到访巴黎的经历。
到访.pinyin: Wǒ yǒng yuǎn bù huì wàng jì qù nián xià tiān dào fǎng bā lí de jīng lì
到访.en: I'll never forget visiting Paris last summer.
到访.es: Nunca olvidaré mi viaje a París del verano pasado.

加大.zh: 政府应该加大对农业的投资。
加大.pinyin: Zhèng fǔ yīng gāi jiā dà duì nóng yè de tóu zī
加大.en: The government should invest more money in agriculture.
加大.es: El gobierno debería invertir más dinero en la agricultura.

合当.pinyin: Tā bù shì hé dāng lǎo shī
合当.en: He is unfit to be a teacher.

后视镜.pinyin: Hòu shì jìng diē le xià lai
Dǎo chē qián xiān kàn hòu shì jìng
后视镜.en: Look in the rear-view mirror before backing up.
后视镜.es: Mira por el retrovisor antes de dar marcha atrás.

售.zh: 环保汽车在阿尔及利亚有售吗？
售.pinyin: Huán bǎo qì chē zài ā ěr jí lì yà yǒu shòu ma
售.en: Are eco-friendly cars sold in Algeria?

售.zh: 因为气温很高，有大量空调售出。
售.pinyin: Yīn wèi qì wēn hěn gāo yǒu dà liàng kōng tiáo shòu chū
售.en: A large quantity of air-conditioners has been sold since the temperature is high.

地理学.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan dì lǐ xué hé lì shǐ
地理学.es: Me gustan la geografía y la historia.

垮.zh: 他干活太用功，把身体弄垮了。
垮.pinyin: Tā gàn huó tài yòng gōng bǎ shēn tǐ nòng kuǎ le
垮.en: He worked too hard and destroyed his health.

声线.zh: 他压低声线，喃喃自语地说了些话。
声线.pinyin: Tā yā dī shēng xiàn nán nán zì yǔ de shuō le xiē huà
声线.en: He muttered something under his breath.
声线.es: Él rezongó algo en voz baja.

声线.zh: 我被她甜美的声线迷倒了。
声线.pinyin: Wǒ bèi tā tián měi de shēng xiàn mí dǎo le
声线.en: I was fascinated by her sweet voice.

常春藤.zh: 西洋常春藤是攀缘藤本植物。
常春藤.pinyin: Xī yáng cháng chūn téng shì pān yuán téng běn zhí wù
常春藤.en: English ivy is a climbing vine.

常春藤.zh: 花园里开始冒出常春藤。
常春藤.pinyin: Huā yuán lǐ kāi shǐ mào chū cháng chūn téng
常春藤.en: Ivy started growing in the garden.

开户.pinyin: Qǐng wèn wǒ kě yǐ kāi hù tou ma
开户.en: May I ask, can I open a bank account?

循规蹈矩.zh: 有些人喜欢循规蹈矩，而有些人总喜欢寻求刺激。
循规蹈矩.pinyin: Yǒu xiē rén xǐ huan xún guī dǎo jǔ ér yǒu xiē rén zǒng xǐ huan xún qiú cì jī
循规蹈矩.en: Some people prefer conformity, while others seek novelty.

循规蹈矩.zh: 根据习俗，新娘应该循规蹈矩。
循规蹈矩.pinyin: Gēn jù xí sú xīn niáng yīng gāi xún guī dǎo jǔ
循规蹈矩.en: According to custom, the bride should be compliant.

惊醒.zh: 我觉得我好像从恶梦中惊醒。
惊醒.pinyin: Wǒ jué de wǒ hǎo xiàng cóng è mèng zhōng jīng xǐng
惊醒.en: I feel as if I've woken up from a nightmare.
惊醒.es: Me siento como si hubiera despertado de una pesadilla.

惊醒.zh: 他很小心地溜出房间，以免惊醒她。
惊醒.pinyin: Tā hěn xiǎo xīn de liū chū fáng jiān yǐ miǎn jīng xǐng tā
惊醒.en: He crept out of the room very carefully to avoid waking her up.
惊醒.es: Salió sigilosamente de la habitación con mucho cuidado con el fin de evitar despertarla.

撒野.pinyin: Jié kè bù yào nà me sā yě

救世主.zh: 从来就没有什么救世主， 也不靠神仙皇帝！
救世主.pinyin: Cóng lái jiù méi yǒu shén me jiù shì zhǔ yě bù kào shén xiān huáng dì
救世主.en: There has never been a savior nor an immortal emperor to rely on.

新政.pinyin: Tā men xuǎn chū le xīn zhèng fǔ
新政.en: They have elected a new government.
新政.es: Ellos han elegido un nuevo gobierno.

明子.pinyin: Wǒ xǐ huan xìng zi shèng guò míng zi
明子.en: I like Sachiko better than Akiko.
明子.es: Me gusta más Sachiko que Akiko.

明子.zh: 明子在法国有一些朋友。
明子.pinyin: Míng zi zài fǎ guó yǒu yī xiē péng you
明子.en: Akiko has some friends in France.
明子.es: Akiko tiene algunos amigos en Francia.

水汽.zh: 当水被加热时，水汽蒸发。
水汽.pinyin: Dāng shuǐ bèi jiā rè shí shuǐ qì zhēng fā
水汽.en: Water evaporates when it is heated.
水汽.es: El agua se evapora cuando se calienta.

水汽.pinyin: Yún shì tiān kōng zhòng dì shuǐ qì tuán
水汽.en: A cloud is a mass of vapor in the sky.

水能.pinyin: Yī dī dī shuǐ néng jù chéng hú pō
水能.en: Drop by drop, the water can conglomerate into a lake.
水能.es: Gota tras gota, el agua se puede juntar hasta hacer un lago.

水能.en: Is it safe to drink this water?

潺潺.pinyin: Xī liú chán chán cuī wǒ rù mián
潺潺.en: The murmur of the brook lulls me to sleep.

炮.pinyin: Ài dí shēng fā míng le diàn dēng bāo
炮.en: Thomas Edison invented the light bulb.

独立战争.zh: 民兵雕像是为了纪念独立战争中英勇作战的士兵。
独立战争.pinyin: Mín bīng diāo xiàng shì wèi le jì niàn dú lì zhàn zhēng zhōng yīng yǒng zuò zhàn dī shì bīng
独立战争.en: The statue of the Minute Man commemorates the valiant soldiers who fought in the Revolutionary War.
独立战争.es: La estatua del Minute Man conmemora a los valientes soldados que lucharon en la Guerra de la Independencia.

独立战争.zh: 约阿夫行动是以色列独立战争中的一次作战行动。
独立战争.pinyin: Yāo ā fū xíng dòng shì yǐ sè liè dú lì zhàn zhēng zhòng dì yī cì zuò zhàn xíng dòng
独立战争.en: Operation Yoav was a military operation carried out by Israel in its war for independence.

相邻.pinyin: Měi guó yǔ jiā ná dà xiāng lín
相邻.es: Estados Unidos de América limita con Canadá.

相邻.pinyin: Yīng gé lán yǔ sū gé lán xiāng lín

篮.pinyin: Tā yǒu yī zhěng lán de píng guǒ
篮.en: She had a basket full of apples.
篮.es: Ella tenía una cesta llena de manzanas.

篮.pinyin: Tā tí zhe yī lán xiān huā
篮.en: She was carrying a basket full of flowers.
篮.es: Ella llevaba una cesta llena de flores.

红润.zh: 我所爱的是白皙红润，千里挑一的。
红润.pinyin: Wǒ suǒ ài de shì bái xī hóng rùn qiān lǐ tiāo yī de
红润.en: My beloved is white and ruddy, chosen out of thousands.

红润.zh: 这个男孩有一张红润的脸。
红润.pinyin: Zhè ge nán hái yǒu yī zhāng hóng rùn de liǎn
红润.en: The boy had a red face.

虎子.pinyin: Bù rù hǔ xué yān de hǔ zǐ
虎子.es: El que nada arriesga, nada tiene.

论定.zh: 从这来看，你能因此论定女权主义还是必要的。
论定.pinyin: Cóng zhè lái kàn nǐ néng yīn cǐ lùn dìng nǚ quán zhǔ yì hái shi bì yào de
论定.en: From this you can conclude that feminism is still necessary.
论定.es: A partir de esto se puede concluir que el feminismo sigue siendo necesario.

论定.zh: 看完研究以后，我们其中大部分人论定疫苗是件好事。
论定.pinyin: Kàn wán yán jiū yǐ hòu wǒ men qí zhōng dà bù fen rén lùn dìng yì miáo shì jiàn hǎo shì
论定.en: After looking at the research, most of us conclude that vaccines are a good thing.

赐福.pinyin: Yuàn nǐ dé dào cì fú

踮.zh: 他踮著脚尖走, 所以没有人听到他。
踮.pinyin: Tā diǎn zhe jiǎo jiān zǒu suǒ yǐ méi yǒu rén tīng dào tā
踮.en: He tiptoed so no one heard him.

踮.zh: 她踮起脚向他耳语，然后走了
踮.pinyin: Tā diǎn qǐ jiǎo xiàng tā ěr yǔ rán hòu zǒu le
踮.en: She stood on tip-toe and whispered something in his ear, and then went away.

转校.pinyin: Qù nián tā zhuǎn xiào le
转校.es: Él cambió de colegio el año pasado.

转校.zh: 听说要来一个转校生之后，全班都乱哄哄地活跃起来。
转校.pinyin: Tīng shuō yào lái yī ge zhuǎn xiào shēng zhī hòu quán bān dōu luàn hōng hōng de huó yuè qǐ lai
转校.en: Hearing that a transfer student was coming, the class buzzed with excitement.

适时.zh: 听说适时地补充水分可以预防中暑。
适时.pinyin: Tīng shuō shì shí de bǔ chōng shuǐ fèn kě yǐ yù fáng zhòng shǔ
适时.en: I hear that keeping yourself hydrated at appropriate times can help prevent heatstroke.

遮.pinyin: Tā bǎ zì jǐ zhē qǐ lai le

醒目.zh: 他额头上的疤痕很醒目。
醒目.pinyin: Tā é tóu shàng de bā hén hěn xǐng mù
醒目.en: The scar on his forehead really stands out.
醒目.es: La cicatriz en su frente resalta.

除以.pinyin: Liù chú yǐ èr de sān
除以.en: Six divided by two is three.

风声.zh: 他一嗅到风声不对，就逃之夭夭了。
风声.pinyin: Tā yī xiù dào fēng shēng bù duì jiù táo zhī yāo yāo le
风声.es: Al sentir el peligro salió corriendo.

风声.zh: 风声有点恐怖，听起来好像鬼叫一般。
风声.pinyin: Fēng shēng yǒu diǎn kǒng bù tīng qi lai hǎo xiàng guǐ jiào yī bān
风声.en: The wind sounds scary, like screaming ghosts.

一劳永逸.zh: 她一劳永逸地告诉我，她不想再见我了。
一劳永逸.pinyin: Tā yī láo yǒng yì de gào su wǒ tā bù xiǎng zài jiàn wǒ le
一劳永逸.en: She told me once and for all that she did not want to see me again.
一劳永逸.es: Ella me dijo de una vez y para siempre que no quería volver a verme.

一号.zh: 我会在七月一号开始上班。
一号.pinyin: Wǒ huì zài qī yuè yī hào kāi shǐ shàng bān
一号.en: I will start working on July first.
一号.es: Empiezo a trabajar el uno de julio.

一小部分.zh: 我们的世界只不过是宇宙的一小部分。
一小部分.pinyin: Wǒ men de shì jiè zhǐ bu guò shì yǔ zhòu de yī xiǎo bù fèn
一小部分.en: Our world is only a small part of the universe.
一小部分.es: Nuestro mundo es sólo una parte pequeña del universo.

上色.pinyin: Mǎ gé wèi tú huà shàng sè

专利权.zh: 英特尔公司由那个发明取得着巨大的专利权收入
专利权.pinyin: Yīng tè ěr gōng sī yóu nà ge fā míng qǔ dé zhe jù dà de zhuān lì quán shōu rù
专利权.en: Intel gets a huge royalty from the invention.

东汉.zh: 普遍认为佛教公元六七年在东汉明帝的统治时先来中国。
东汉.pinyin: Pǔ biàn rèn wéi fó jiào gōng yuán liù qī nián zài dōng hàn míng dì de tǒng zhì shí xiān lái zhōng guó
东汉.en: It is generally believed that Buddhism first came to China in 67 A.D. during the reign of Emperor Mingdi of the Eastern Han Dynasty.
东汉.es: Es una creencia generalizada que el budismo llegó por primera vez a China en el 67 d. C. durante el reinado del Emperador Ming de la dinastía Han Oriental.

乌托邦.zh: 握著我的手。我们两个将要建立一个乌托邦。
乌托邦.pinyin: Wò zhe wǒ de shǒu wǒ men liǎng gè jiāng yào jiàn lì yī ge wū tuō bāng
乌托邦.en: Take my hand. The two of us are going to construct a utopia.
乌托邦.es: Toma mi mano. Los dos vamos a construir una utopía.

书评.pinyin: Wǒ duì zhè běn shū píng jià hěn gāo
书评.en: I have a high opinion of this book.

交情.pinyin: Wǒ gēn tāng mǔ yǒu jiāo qing

交接.zh: 在他们双目交接的瞬间，世界仿佛静止了。
交接.pinyin: Zài tā men shuāng mù jiāo jiē de shùn jiān shì jiè fǎng fú jìng zhǐ le
交接.en: When their eyes met, it was as if the world stood still.

亲属.zh: 你跟长岛一家有亲属关系吗?
亲属.pinyin: Nǐ gēn cháng dǎo yī jiā yǒu qīn shǔ guān xi ma
亲属.en: Are you related to the Nagashimas?

人算不如天算.pinyin: Rén suàn bù rú tiān suàn
人算不如天算.en: A man's will is nothing when compared to that of the heavens.
